1. [blocking][issue-impact] **F1 (high):** Concurrent automated evaluations can still make latest-run disagree with readiness. The checker executes before the record-publication session, so an earlier-started evaluation can publish after a later-started one and overwrite `gates_status` ([gate_check.rs:900](crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:900)). The latest-run view instead selects the greatest checker `started_at` ([gate_check.rs:1237](crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:1237)), selecting the earlier-published result in that schedule. This violates REQ-03; use a publication-order authority shared by the run selection and readiness projection, with a concurrent automated-run test. References: `@/issue/8673dc5e/requirement/REQ-03`.
